subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit (Wk 6)
html:
Tomorrow: 20-min Hip Complex Circuit — mobility only, no running. Two rounds through the full sequence: foam roller T-spine extensions (8–10 reps), standing lunges with hip IR + extension (8–10 each side), quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 each side), 90/90 switches (8–10 each side), adductor rockbacks (8–10), quadruped hip CARs (3 each direction, each leg — slow, sink into IR at bottom), and half-kneeling couch stretch (60 sec each side). All bodyweight, all PT-prescribed or PT-complementary.

Context: Week 6 of 12, Phase 2 (Strength & Threshold) — 48 days to the SF Marathon. You're opening a 30-mile week, the biggest of the plan so far. Yesterday's 12.75-mi long run was the cleanest session of the build — HR discipline nailed (132–143 for 10 aerobic miles under a 155 cap), MP close at 7:27–7:29 with HR 152–157 squarely in the band, knee 1/5, gut handled three PF30 gels with zero GI distress. That's the Phase 2 foundation you're building on.

Focus cue: sink into the hip CARs. Tomorrow is a recovery day between yesterday's long run and Tuesday's big track session, so treat the circuit as a genuine mobility flush — don't rush through the CARs or the couch stretch. The hip IR work is the highest-leverage piece for the patellofemoral presentation; give it the full range of motion.

Eyes forward to Tuesday: the 4×1600m threshold set + the H10 max-HR test is the marquee session of the week. Every HR zone in the plan is anchored to an unconfirmed 180 placeholder — Tuesday pins the real number. Tonight, lay out your track kit and the H10 strap, hydrate well, and get to bed by 10. The circuit tomorrow is light enough that you could do it first thing and still have the full day to recover before Tuesday morning.
